title: Eglin Daily 018 — SHRM26 closing day, Chief Work Officer frame, HCM M&A pace
summary: SHRM CEO Johnny C. Taylor Jr. closed SHRM26 today with a 'Taking Back HR' keynote naming HR leaders as 'Chief Work Officer' — the amplification frame now has three independent anchors inside one conference week (BambooHR presenting sponsor + Sinek + SHRM CEO), directly against Bersin's 30-50% headcount-cut framing. Compass + Vector ship the three-anchor language deck by Friday; Helm + Compass decide on a 600-word Stratum piece this week. Q1 2026 WorkTech M&A pace confirmed at 40 transactions and $1.9B venture investment with at least 15 (38%) citing AI as the deal rationale (Findem/Glider, HireVue/Hireguide, Lattice/Mandala, Phenom/Be Applied + Included AI, Docebo/365Talents); HCM platforms absorb 80% of WorkTech capital — Eglin will refresh competitor-acquisition battlecards this week. EU AI Act Annex III consultation re-elevated for a seventh brief without Compact movement; Forge + Helm own the file/do-not-file call by Friday EOD regardless of the 6/23-vs-7/23 deadline ambiguity Eglin owes a portal-verified correction on tomorrow; after Friday this drops from the daily and moves to the weekly decisions-overdue tracker. Top alert L3.
